results.title: Introducing ProtoPie AI (Now in Beta)
results.content:
A note on beta: ProtoPie AI is launching in open beta, which means we’re continuously refining and improving the experience based on real-world usage. You’ll see enhancements roll out in the coming weeks and months as we learn from how teams actually use AI in their workflows.

## See ProtoPie AI in Action

ProtoPie AI represents an important shift, not just faster prototyping, but better prototyping at scale. High-fidelity and test-readiness is the metric that matters. [...] ###### ProtoPie,

We are thrilled to announce ProtoPie AI–now available in open beta starting February 9, 2026, for Basic, Pro, and Enterprise plan users.

If you’ve explored AI prototyping tools, you’ve probably noticed a pattern: they help you start fast, but finishing properly becomes the challenge. AI generates something quickly, but when you need to refine behavior, adjust logic, or scale complexity, you hit a wall. [...] Ready to experience it yourself? Our team is standing by to walk you through a personalized demo and answer any questions you may have.

results.title: ProtoPie AI is Officially Here: Supercharge Your Prototyping with Component AI
results.content:
###### Iulia Sorodoc, Product Marketing Manager at ProtoPie

protopie ai official launch

We are excited to announce that ProtoPie AI has officially graduated from its open beta phase.

Based directly on your feedback, this official release is much more than a label change. We are introducing powerful Component AI authoring, an entirely revamped and transparent billing system, and crucial stability fixes. Here is everything you need to know. [...] ## Major update: Say hello to component AI authoring

One of the limitations during our beta was that AI could not easily manage or create reusable components. With this official launch, ProtoPie AI now supports local component authoring. You can seamlessly convert existing layers into local components, add or swap component instances, and override component variables entirely through natural language prompts.

creating component in protopie with ai [...] Our Creative Technologist, Mickey, puts the AI to the test with real prompts, unedited outputs, and a live Q&A session tackling real scenarios from designers and product teams.

Watch the Demo

## Looking ahead

The official release of ProtoPie AI is a leap forward for scalable, high-fidelity prototyping. By combining the speed of natural language generation with the precision of manual editing, we are helping you build test-ready prototypes faster than ever before.
